articles.title: A Tiny Adventure Time Episode That Turned Out to Be Huge
articles.summary: A look back at the 13-year-old episode 'Simon & Marcy' shows how a ten-minute story explained the Ice King's past and shaped the whole series.

articles.title: Why Street Fighter's New Cammy Looks So Familiar
articles.summary: Mel Jarnson plays Cammy in the new 2026 Street Fighter film, after earlier roles in Mortal Kombat, Blacklight, Witchboard, and Killer Whale.

articles.title: Most Readers Say Flying Cars Are Not Ready to Take Off Yet
articles.summary: After Tesla's Rocket Roadster demonstration last week, most Live Science readers polled said flying cars need more than five years, or will never happen.
